title: Tulfo: Unused P104-M Covid-19 syringes expiring in 2027

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Approximately P104 million worth of unused vaccine syringes procured by the government during the Covid-19 pandemic is set to expire in 2027, Sen. Raffy Tulfo said on Friday. During the Department of Health’s P274-billion budget deliberations at the Senate, Tulfo discussed the stocks of government-procured medical supplies and medicines left at the agency’s Tala Warehouse in Caloocan. “During my Senate team’s inspection tumambad ang napakaraming boxes na approximately 16 million unused na mga syringes intended for Covid-19 vaccination… Na-stuck ang mga ito mula 2022 at mag-eexpire sa 2027,” Tulfo reported.
